devices.name: Mutelcor - LoRa Air Quality Sensor (IP30, IP67)
devices.description: The Mutelcor LoRa Air Quality Sensor is a LoRaWAN® Device that measures wirelessly Temperature and Humidity in Regfrigerators, Deep Freezers, including indoor applications like Corporate Buildings & Healthcare centers (ICUs Operation Theatre & Medical Labs) and Triggers alarms on exceeded thresholds.

devices.name: Mutelcor - LoRa Air Quality Button (IP30, IP54)
devices.description: The Mutelcor LoRa Air Quality Button is a LoRaWAN® Device that combines sending LoRa messages on a button press with measuring wirelessly Temperature and Humidity. Can be used for indoor applications like Corporate Buildings & Healthcare centers to combine monitoring of the Air Quality with an integrated Service Call Button or Emergency Button.

devices.name: Mutelcor - LoRa Alarm Unit - Class C
devices.description: The Mutelcor LoRa Alarm Unit is a unique power connected LoRa Class C device that can be used either independently or with our other products like LoRa Panic Button with Confirmation or Smart CO2 LoRa Sensor to siren Alarms and Alerts. Up to 4 different Alarm-Types can be configured on the device with customizable LED Color Buzzer behavior per Alarm-Type.

devices.name: Mutelcor - LoRa Alarm Unit (Battery)
devices.description: The Mutelcor LoRa Alarm Unit is a unique, battery operated device that can be used either independently or with our other products like LoRa Panic Button with Confirmation or Smart CO2 LoRa Sensor to siren Alarms and Alerts. Up to 4 different Alarm-Types can be configured on the device with customizable LED Color Buzzer behavior per Alarm-Type.

devices.name: Mutelcor - LoRa Customer Feedback
devices.description: The Mutelcor LoRa Customer Feedback is an end-to-end feedback monitoring device leveraging LoRaWAN® Technology. An easy to use device with 3 smiley-buttons which facilitates to gather, analyse and report user feedback in real time.

devices.name: Mutelcor - Smart CO2 LoRa Sensor (IP30, IP54)
devices.description: The Mutelcor Smart CO2 LoRa Sensor is a unique power-driven Air Quality sensor. It measures CO2, Temperature and Humidity every 2 seconds with a robust dual-channel NDIR sensor and offers automatic Traffic Light Feature with local and LoRa-based Alarms based on multi-color LEDs and Sound. The device offers plug-and-play handling with multiple Threshold settings and quick and easy Calibration.

devices.name: Mutelcor - LoRa Wireless CO2 Sensor
devices.description: The Mutelcor Wireless CO2 Sensor is the batteryu powered version of our well known Smart CO2 LoRa Sensor. It measures CO2 levels along with temperature and humidity at configurable intervals, by default once every hour. With that configuration, we're able to achieve a battery life of about 2 years. Ideal for installations where regular monitoring of CO2 levels is required, but real time alerts are not critical, e.g. mushroom farming, industrial complexes and many more.

devices.name: Mutelcor - LoRa Multi-Function Device
devices.description: The Mutelcor LoRa Multi-Function Device is a LoRaWAN® Device that allows you to connect up to 3 external switches. Whenever the status of a connected switch changes, a LoRa message is sent indicating which switch status changed and what the status of the other connected switches is. Can be used to combine e.g. monitoring of a manhole cover with a float sensor inside the manhole to alert on a rising water level.

devices.name: Mutelcor - LoRa Manhole Sensor
devices.description: The Mutelcor LoRa Manhole Sensor is a LoRaWAN® Device that detects opening and closing of manholes and/or any external doors. The device notifies alerts in real time to prevent accidents and to quickly react to unauthorized opening of manholes and external doors.

devices.name: Mutelcor - NFC RFID - LoRa Button
devices.description: The Mutelcor NFC RFID - LoRa Button makes it easy to combine sending alarm messages via LoRa with an option to authenticate using a NFC Tag by holding it next to the device when pressing a button. Our dynamic web-dashboard allows you to monitor the status of deployed NFC RFID - LoRa Buttons, handle events sent and collect statistics about device usage. Other Mutelcor products can be monitored using the same dashboard.

devices.name: Mutelcor - LoRa Panic Button with Confirmation
devices.description: The Mutelcor LoRa Panic Button with Confirmation is a LoRaWAN® emergency response device that enables users to quickly raise an alarm, notify security and to seek assistance in a matter of seconds by pressing a button. Its unique confirmation feature can indicate if the button-press has been received and acknowledged by the backend application. A physical feedback to the button press using a buzzer and LED can be configured.

devices.name: Mutelcor - LoRa PM2.5 Sensor
devices.description: The Mutelcor LoRa PM2.5 Sensor measures particulate matter values PM1.0, PM2.5 and PM10 at a configurable interval and transmits the values via LoRaWAN allowing the calculation of AQI and creation of alerts when crossing thresholds in the backend application. It detects particles as small as 0.3 µm using a Laser-scattering sensor.

devices.name: Mutelcor - LoRa Service Call Button
devices.description: The Mutelcor LoRa Service Call Button is a LoRaWAN® Device that raises alarms or requests to multiple services for help, assistance or support from a single device in real time in a matter of seconds by pressing a button. A physical feedback to the button press using a buzzer and LED can be configured.

devices.name: Mutelcor - LoRa Siren Unit
devices.description: The Mutelcor LoRa Siren Unit is a unique power connected LoRa Class C device with an inbuilt 110 dB Siren that can be used either independently or with our other products like LoRa Panic Button with Confirmation or Smart CO2 LoRa Sensor to siren Alarms and Alerts. Up to 4 different Alarm-Types can be configured on the device with customizable LED Color and Siren behavior per Alarm-Type.
